evidence.reason: The switch does not require the checkout to be detached before switching: the supplied code only checks status and records `rev-parse HEAD`. If an initially attached checkout is moved by the forward checkout and the later `switch-render` audit or config write fails, the exception path reaches line 881 and forces `--detach` while restoring `previous`. The commit and config are restored, but an originally branch-attached host comes back detached at the same commit. Recording the original symbolic ref and restoring it only when it still names `previous` (keeping detached otherwise) is the minimal compatible fix; successful forward switches remain detached.
